schema_version: v0 — skill-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The learning door over the chart device's trees: /moreabout <something> resolves a too-compressed field from the upstream nexus's already-deposited state (a counsel walk with berthed packets attached — a walk, never a re-run) and writes the invocation back to that tree as a dated moreabout_signal node, one embed serving both. Tenant-generic through the same mouth: chart's nexi, orient's corrections, the inspector's failures.
why: The ratifying intent's own words (Akien, 2026-07-28): '/chart <something> --- learning from /moreabout <something>'. Until this door, the trees are write-mostly — counsel works but nothing in the standing workflow invokes a walk instead of silently re-reading a compressed field; the training signal has no mouth. The skill-door facts apply doubly here: the signal must be un-skippable, so it rides INSIDE the one command (an opt-in signal would be skipped exactly when the honest datum is least flattering). Device charter: cairn/chart/intention+why.json (falsifier 4 — answered-by-re-run — is this skill's red line); ticket: CairnCommons/tickets/moreabout.json.
state: v0 — cast 2026-07-28 on 'the word is given', the same day the tree stratum and both grafts proved. The sibling of /chart (the skill pair).

nexus.note: SKILL.md carries the live sequence; this is the charter-face record.
nexus.routes_forward: ask -> one live verb (walk + signal) -> answer from deposited state, per-node similarity and provenance visible
nexus.routes_back: empty walk -> say so; the landed signal IS the datum. Under-floor -> ranked nodes shown flagged, reader decides. Missing answer -> a fresh /chart forward, never a quiet re-run.

how_it_learns: This skill IS the device's learning mechanism (2) — every invocation is a labeled datum ('this field, at this compression, wasn't enough for this class') deposited to the upstream tree; duplicates read as frequency. Its walks are also the routine evidence stream for the floor-tuning edge (chart-tree edge (d)) — the n=3 hand-fired evidence becomes n=many by use.
traces_to: Law 1 (a compressed field resolves from structure, never by re-running the pass that compressed it)
Law 3 (every invocation a measured walk + a dated signal)
Law 4 (no-re-run is import physics in moreabout.py; the signal un-skippable by living inside the one verb)
owner: the skills charter gates writes; Akien ratifies changes (signature gate). The trees written are each tenant's own table through db_domain's gate.

counted_by.address: the tenant trees in db_domain — nodes whose provenance.kind is 'moreabout_signal'
counted_by.what_it_counts: EXACT, and exact by construction rather than by care: the walk and the write-back are one act inside one command, so a firing that produced no signal did not happen. Measured 2026-08-04: 2 (one in chart_orient_nodes, one in orient_corrections_nodes).
counted_by.why_not_the_seam: the signal IS the firing record, and it is deposited where the learning it tunes lives — in the tree it is evidence about. Moving the count to a skill trace would separate the datum from the thing it is a datum ABOUT, which is the split Law 5 exists to prevent.
counted_by.the_number_is_the_finding: 2 invocations in the seven days since the door was built. Either the fields are not too compressed, or the door is not being reached for. This count cannot tell those apart and does not pretend to; that is Akien's judgement and it is the disuse clause's whole shape.
counted_by.when_the_db_is_down: the row reads 'unreadable' with the reason, NEVER 0 — an unreachable store is not an empty one (Law 7).

proof: the device's proof carries the machinery (cairn/chart/proofs/test_chart_moreabout.py — 7 teeth, tester-sealed: deposited-state walk, under-floor honesty, attach-only-what-exists, dated signal, standing-tree refusals, readable dedup, no-re-run import physics); the skill node additionally hangs the cairnmap recompile gate (IOU until cairnmap exists, per the skill class).
provenance: Cast 2026-07-28, minutes after 'CC++ on the floor evidence. /moreabout is next then?' — 'the word is given'. Design: chart-tree filed edge (a) ('the learning door over this same tree; next stone of the skill pair') + the charter's how_it_learns (2), with the same-day under-floor evidence (0.5775 correct-but-under) folded in as the honesty rule.
